solution.title: Configuration Manager and Intune Co-Management Enablement

products.name: Configuration Manager and Intune Co-Management Enablement — Commercial
products.short_description: Enable co-management so a single Windows device is managed by Configuration Manager and Intune together — then move workloads to the cloud one at a time, on your schedule. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Bridge Configuration Manager and Intune — move workloads to the cloud at your own pace

You have years of investment in Configuration Manager, but management is moving to the cloud and you can't rip-and-replace overnight. Co-management lets a single Windows device be managed by Configuration Manager and Intune at the same time, so you shift workloads — compliance, updates, endpoint protection, configuration, app deployment — from Configuration Manager to Intune one at a time, on your schedule, with a clean path to cloud-first. This solution enables co-management correctly and gives you a controlled workload-by-workload migration.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how co-management works, the Configuration Manager + Intune authority model, the co-management workloads (compliance, updates, endpoint protection, device configuration, Office Click-to-Run, client apps), and the staged workload-slider approach.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (supported Configuration Manager current branch, Intune, Entra ID, hybrid or Entra join, Entra Connect, the cloud attach / tenant attach configuration) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: prepare identity and licensing, enable co-management in Configuration Manager, onboard a pilot collection, move one workload at a time to Intune, validate each, then expand and plan cloud-first.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — co-management readiness discovery, co-management state validation per device, a workload-authority and enrollment report, safe remediation of un-enrolled clients, and a co-management pilot group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Your Configuration Manager fleet co-managed with Intune — workloads moving to the cloud one controlled step at a time, with a clear path to cloud-first — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • COMGMT-Discovery.ps1 — Co-management readiness discovery (READ-ONLY)
    • COMGMT-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation for un-enrolled co-management clients
    • COMGMT-Report.ps1 — Fleet co-management enrollment + workload-authority report (READ-ONLY)
    • COMGMT-Set-CoMgmtPilotTargeting.ps1 — Build the co-management pilot collection membership
    • COMGMT-Validation.ps1 — Per-device co-management state validation (READ-ONLY)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
